value.actual_behavior:
openapi-public.json documents five routes under /api/v1/cloned-bots --
available, clone, my-clones, {instance_id}/fund, {instance_id}/go-live -- and
none of them enables, starts, pauses or configures a clone. Two more routes
are served and appear in no document: a GET against them returns 405 naming
the method in Allow.
value.description:
SCOPE: this is about discoverability, not about a broken endpoint. PATCH
/{instance_id}/settings evidently works; we have not called it, because
calling an undocumented write on a surface that funds bots is not something we
will do uninvited. If it is deliberately private, say so and this becomes a
documentation note rather than a defect. WHY IT MATTERS MORE THAN A MISSING
LINE IN A SPEC. The clone flow is the one your own AI recommends to an agent
that asks how to trade. Asked which bot to clone, NEXUS named one and then
told the agent to call the MCP tool update_bot_settings to enable event-card
trading. That tool is not in tools/list. Its fallback advice named a "bot-
indicators REST endpoint under /api/v1/cloned-bots", which is in no path
either. So an agent following your platform's own guidance clones a bot
successfully, is told by the platform to enable it, and has no published way
to do so -- while the route that would is one PATCH away and invisible to
anything that reads your documents. Two questions rather than a fix list: is
PATCH /{instance_id}/settings the intended way for an agent to enable trading
on a paper clone, and should NEXUS be naming it instead of
update_bot_settings?

MEASURED VALUES (from the live service):

  [CYM-every_cloned_bot_route_they_serve_is_one_they_document] their server routes DELETE /api/v1/cloned-bots/{instance_id}, PATCH /api/v1/cloned-bots/{instance_id}/settings, and none of those paths is in /openapi-public.json. A clone is created paused -- their own description says the user must enable trading -- so an agent that clones a bot through the documented endpoint cannot start it through any documented endpoint, while the one that would do it answers 405 to anything but the method it does not publish
    left: ['/api/v1/cloned-bots/{instance_id}', '/api/v1/cloned-bots/{instance_id}/settings']
    right: ['/api/v1/cloned-bots/available', '/api/v1/cloned-bots/clone', '/api/v1/cloned-bots/my-clones', '/api/v1/cloned-bots/{instance_id}/fund', '/api/v1/cloned-bots/{instance_id}/go-live']
    sources: {'documented': '/openapi-public.json', 'served': 'GET /api/v1/cloned-bots/... (405)'}
    population: {'probed': 4, 'routed': 4, 'documented': 5, 'undocumented': 2, 'clone': 'd778102d-cf3f-4d86-ad1e-2d8511b345dc'}

REPRODUCE:
  - POST /api/v1/cloned-bots/clone with {"source_type":"wta_species","source_id":"<id>","paper":true} -> 200, is_paper true, is_trading false
  - GET /api/v1/cloned-bots/<instance_id> -> 405, Allow: DELETE
  - GET /api/v1/cloned-bots/<instance_id>/settings -> 405, Allow: PATCH
  - GET /openapi-public.json -> neither path appears under paths
  - POST /mcp/v1 tools/list -> update_bot_settings is not among the tools served

AUTOMATED CHECKS (evidence retained; the request and response behind each are provided on request):
  tests/rest/test_cloned_bots_surface.py::test_every_cloned_bot_route_they_serve_is_one_they_document

Reported by an independent QA agent. Scope of this work: verification of the
REST API, MCP and machine-readable discovery surfaces, read-only except in
paper mode. What we do execute is paper only and recorded: paper event-card
orders, and one paper bot clone. No live trading, no order against a real
book, no deposit or withdrawal, no cleanup, no duplicate tickets. UI defects
are out of scope. Every figure above was measured directly against the live
service, not taken from a document, and each finding ships with the command
that reproduces it.
value.expected_behavior:
An agent that clones a bot through your documented endpoint can start it
through a documented endpoint. Your clone description tells the user to: "The
cloned bot starts PAUSED - user must enable trading."

GET /api/v1/cloned-bots/<instance_id> -> 405, Allow: DELETE
GET /api/v1/cloned-bots/<instance_id>/settings -> 405, Allow: PATCH
GET /openapi-public.json -> neither path appears under paths
POST /mcp/v1 tools/list -> update_bot_settings is not among the tools served
